source.scope_note: Atoms represent independently reviewable assertions reported in the main PDF. Published comparator values from prior studies were not comprehensively atomized; only the same-split CLAM comparator was retained because it is directly part of the study result table.

extraction_limitations: The source is an unedited article-in-press manuscript and states that errors may remain before final publication.
No supplementary files were supplied or extracted.
This is source-grounded atom extraction, not independent verification or methodological appraisal.
The atom schema permits one normalized quantitative result per atom, so distinct metrics and perturbation outcomes were split into separate atoms.
Table 7 does not state per-row sample sizes; those atoms preserve that gap rather than inferring denominators from other tables.
Published contextual comparator rows were generally not atomized because they report findings from other primary publications rather than new results generated by this study.
